The delayed-response and error-recovery tests cover those fixes. Read-only, in-memory checks of the actual effect also passed. No new actionable defects found in `master..HEAD`.

entries.text: Fix the independent review findings in a second commit. The full review is in /artifacts/filming/review-findings.txt. Serialize refreshes so slow responses cannot restore old history. Invalidate pending HEAD and GET responses after cleanup or a change to a read-only snapshot. Clear a transient error when an accepted refresh succeeds. Add regression tests with delayed responses and error recovery, then run the local vp checks. Keep the scope small, preserve the first commit, and commit the fix separately. The earlier restrictions still apply.
I’ll read the review findings, then update refresh handling and add delayed-response tests. I’ll preserve the first commit and make this fix in a separate commit, with the same restrictions.
